backup.production_rule: Expand only: one new function, public.staff_signin_list_v1(), granted to anon and authenticated. No table, column, grant on an existing object or data change. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup, re-read the clock, then fill both (fill-restore-point.mjs does it). Take a fresh backup if the one named is more than an hour old at apply time.

forward_verification.name: function_exists_definer_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 and bool_and(p.prosecdef and p.proconfig = array['search_path=""']) from pg_proc p where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and p.proname = 'staff_signin_list_v1'

forward_verification.name: grants_anon_and_authenticated_only
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('anon','public.staff_signin_list_v1()','execute') and has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.staff_signin_list_v1()','execute') and not exists (select 1 from pg_proc p, aclexplode(p.proacl) a where p.oid = 'public.staff_signin_list_v1()'::regprocedure and a.grantee = 0)

forward_verification.name: result_shape_is_label_handle_kind
forward_verification.query: select pg_get_function_result('public.staff_signin_list_v1()'::regprocedure) = 'TABLE(label text, handle text, kind text)'

forward_verification.name: every_listed_account_is_active_and_kind_matches_the_domain
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from public.staff_signin_list_v1() l where l.kind <> case when l.handle like '%@staff.cascade.invalid' then 'pin' else 'password' end or coalesce(l.label,'') = '') and (select count(*) from public.staff_signin_list_v1()) = (select count(*) from public.staff_access_profiles p join auth.users u on u.id = p.user_id where p.disabled_at is null and u.deleted_at is null and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until <= now()) and coalesce(u.email,'') <> '')

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: Apply supabase/rollbacks/20261005_staff_signin_list.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh: it drops the one function. Nothing else changed. The Cascade Staff sign-in screen then cannot fill its name list; roll the app back too.

feature_flags.name: sql_then_app
feature_flags.required_state: Apply this release BEFORE the Cascade Staff repo with the redesigned sign-in is pushed to GitHub Pages: the new screen calls staff_signin_list_v1 on every open and falls back to a typed name or e-mail until the function exists.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
restore_point or verified_at is still empty or still the PENDING placeholder
the rehearsal has not run the pgTAP suite green on this commit
the Cascade Staff repo is pushed before this release is applied
